programme.desc: Um artista marcial concorda em espiar um senhor do crime solitário usando o seu convite para um torneio no local como desculpa. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: Momento de Justiça 4
programme.desc: Tommy (Phillip Rhee) é apanhado numa perigosa rede de mafiosos Russos, violência e contrafacção. Com o disco utilizado pelo tesouro americano para imprimir dinheiro nas suas mãos, os mafiosos interceptaram um camião com papel de nota em branco, para conseguirem fazer “as verdadeiras”. Tommy torna-se subitamente no alvo da perseguição furiosa depois de, sem saber, lhe ser plantado o disco. Classificação etária: M/12.

programme.title: O Marine 4: Alvo em Movimento
programme.desc: Jake Carter é encarregado de proteger uma “mercadoria de alto valor” — uma denunciante que procura denunciar a corrupção de um fornecedor de defesa do exército. Classificação etária: M/16.

programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades.

programme.title: Waldbühne 1999 - A Romantic Opera Night
programme.desc: This concert at the Waldbühne in Berlin celebrates the legacy of Wagner and his most famous successor, Richard Strauss. This concert features the Berliner Philharmoniker, soloist Ben Heppner, and is directed by James Levine, Metropolitan Opera's music director for nearly 40 years. Strauss's works on the evening program include Don Juan, op. 20; Cäcilie and Heimliche Aufforderung, Op. 27; Zueignung, Op.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’ (1835-1921) Symphony No. 3, Op. 78. Geert Bierling stars as soloist on the organ of De Doelen. It was recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Saint-Saëns Symphony No. 3 was completed in 1886. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Finzi, Duparc a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Ilja Aksionov (Lithuania, 1996) and pianist Gustas Raudonius (Lithuania, 1996) perform Bart Visman’s Het goud van Vermeer; ‘As I lay in the early sun’ from Gerald Finzi’s Oh fair to see, Op. 13b; Henri Duparc’s Extase; Claude Debussy’s Paysage sentimental, L. 55; ‘Mausfallensprüchlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Sechs Lieder; ‘Krysolov’ (The pied piper) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op. 38; Franz Schubert’s Rastlose Liebe, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Baroque Christmas Concert
programme.desc: This splendid Christmas concert was recorded live from the Freiburg Cathedral in 1999. It features soprano Barbara Bonney, recognized worldwide for the clarity of her voice and the precision of her diction, and the baritone Matthias Goerne, one of the most promising singers of his generation.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Intro and Rondo Capriccioso, Op. 28
programme.desc: The Waldbühne in Berlin, one of the most appealing outdoor amphitheatres on the European continent, is the home of the Berliner Philharmoniker’s summer concerts. With over 22.000 in attendance, they are some of the most popular classical music concerts in the world.

programme.title: Janácek - Glagolitic Mass
programme.desc: Mariss Jansons conducts the chorus and instrumental ensemble of the Bavarian Radio Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Janácek’s Glagolitic Mass (1926) at the Lucerne Easter Festival of 2012. The work is divided into eight sections that give the greatest prominence to the chorus while also containing impressive solos, especially for soprano and tenor.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Brahms, Britten a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Vassia Alati (the Netherlands/Greece, 1992) and pianist Yuto Kiguchi (Japan, 1989) perform ‘C’est l’extase langoureuse’ from Claude Debussy’s Arriettes oubliées, L. 63, and ‘Fantoches’ from Debussy’s Fêtes galantes, L. 86; Bart Visman’s Het goud van Vermeer; ‘Lerchengesang’ from Johannes Brahms’s Vier Gesänge, Op. 70; Franz Schubert’s Gruppe aus dem Tartarus, Op. 24, No. 1, D.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 1. Op. 1
programme.desc: Piano soloist Boris Berezovsky is accompanied by the Moscow Philharmonic Orchestra under the baton of Alexander Sladkovsky in a performance of Sergei Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto no. 1, Op. 1. Rachmaninov composed his first concerto while studying at the Moscow Conservatory at the age of 18. The concert opens with 'Heavenly Movement', a composition by the young Russian composer Elmir Nizamov (*1986).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Christmas Concert
programme.desc: On 18 December 2017, the Valerius Ensemble played a Christmas concert in Concordia, Enschede. The ensemble consists of Robert Windak (violin), Annemarie van Vliegen (violin), Eva Šušliková (viola) and Réne Geesing (cello). The program consists of “Das neugeborne Kindelein” from Bachs Cantata BWV 122, the Largo from Vivaldi’s Winter, the Allegro from Mozart’s Divertimento in D (KV.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 1, Op. 68
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra performed a program including Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 1.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janácek, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janácek’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan.

programme.title: Schumann - Carnaval, Op. 9
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann wrote Carnaval, Op. 9 in 1834–1835. It consists of 21 short pieces representing masked revelers at Carnival, a festival before Lent.

programme.title: Josquin - Missa Pange Lingua
programme.desc: The master of metamorphosis: that too is Josquin Desprez. In his masses he prefers working with existing material, by means of skilful cutting and pasting, literal quotation, or imaginative paraphrase. In the Missa Pange lingua, for example, the basic plainchant melody becomes like putty in Josquin’s expert hands.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 25 & Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Stefano Conticello leads the Orchestra of Teatro Comunale di Bologna in a Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart program. The concert opens with the Overture from Mozart’s popular opera “The Magic Flute”. This is followed by Piano Concerto No. 25 in C major, K. 503, with Maurizio Baglini as the featured soloist. Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 25 is just one of the twelve great piano concertos he composed during 1784 and 1786.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the 'Symphony of a Thousand.' The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime.

programme.title: Bachfest 2010
programme.desc: András Schiff (Budapest, 1953) is one of the world's most distinguished pianists, breathing life into pieces with sheer magic. Schiff, a guardian of almost-forgotten ideals of piano playing, is more than a great pianist: he is an expert with insight that goes beyond the piano music, delving deeper into the wider field and macro culture.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction & Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Recursivo
programme.desc: The Mexico City Ballet (MXCB) is a contemporary ballet company made up of highly experienced international dancers, residents of Mexico City. International guest dancers help celebrate the anniversary gala of the Mexico City Ballet, featuring the fantastic works of MXCB’s resident choreographer, Yazmín Barragán.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra
programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. The slowly starting opening movement of the symphony depicts the awakening of nature in spring.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Puccini - La bohème
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo. About his choice for this updated version, Herheim explained: “In bringing La bohème into a present-day setting with this new production we hope to revive the immediate power of suggestion and importance that this work at one time revelled in.

programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Sing Jazz, Singapore
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Great Guitarists - Collage
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends’ unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery’s virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Burton & Ozone - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano & Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald in Brussels: The American Songbook
programme.desc: ‘Ella Fitzgerald: Live in '57’ features ‘The First Lady Of Song’ in a distinct performance. It's the earliest known complete concert of Ella to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium, this 1957 concert sees her performing with jazz greats Ray Brown, Herb Ellis, Jo Jones and the legendary Oscar Peterson on classics such as ‘Lullaby Of Birdland’ and ‘It Don’t Mean A Thing (If It Ain’t Got That Swing)’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Affirmation
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Baden Powell Quartet - Jazz Samba
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: Vocal Acrobats: Passion of an Improvised Journey
programme.desc: One vocalist from Paris and the other from Bern, and two contrasting personalities. Brought together by a chance encounter in 2014, the two singers were surprised to discover how much they had in common: they both do more than just sing well. Leïla Martial and Andreas Schaerer intend to explore and experiment, stretching their vocal boundaries.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Christian Scott - The Centennial Trilogy
programme.desc: In just a few years, young trumpet player Christian Scott has become synonymous with a new jazz generation. He shakes up the conventions of jazz by taking the genre to new horizons and reaching a wider audience. No doubt, at 33 years old, Christian Scott is already forging his own path. After each record release, he seems even more determined to challenge the rules of jazz with his own avant-garde style.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Playa del Carmen
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: Free & Afro Jazz
programme.desc: The term 'jam-session' was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call 'jammin 'the beat'.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Carlinhos Brown
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Bergen Sessions: Erlend Apneseth Trio
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson & Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Portrait: North Sea Round Town
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: The Doobie Brothers - Live At Wolf Trap
programme.desc: Filmed in high definition on 25 July 2004 at Wolf Trap National Park for the Performing Arts in Virginia, 'Live At Wolf Trap' captures The Doobie Brothers in fine form on a set that mixes classic hits with some rarely performed tracks from across their extensive catalogue.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the world famous Circus Krone in Munich, this AC/DC concert from June 17, 2003 features standout performances of 'Rock N Roll Damnation' and 'What's Next To The Moon' and more.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Kasabian - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: R.E.M. - Live in Milan 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic R.E.M. featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Losing My Religion', 'Drive', 'Man On the Moon' and many more.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Sheryl Crow - Miles From Memphis Live at the Pantages Theatre
programme.desc: Filmed in November 2010 in the palatial surroundings of the wonderful art deco Pantages Theatre in Hollywood, this concert film captures Sheryl Crow on tour in support of her recent hit album '100 Miles From Memphis'. The set pulls tracks from across her career and is peppered with hit singles and her best loved album tracks as well as highlights from the new album.

programme.title: Oasis - Live at Wembley Arena 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Oasis featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Champagne Supernova', 'Don’t Look Back In Anger', 'Rock N Roll Star' and many more.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Robbie Williams - Live at the Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: A brand new show that brings a veteran artist at his best! The talented artist, who became famous in the group 'Take That', lacks presentations, but he himself begins his show by saying: 'Let me resubmit ...'. Robbie Williams has the ability to reinvent himself, exhibiting so much energy that he seems to be a rookie artist.

programme.title: Grace Mitchell - Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Avril Lavigne - Live in Calgary
programme.desc: The Canadian Avril Lavigne enchanted the public in 2007 at her show in Calgary (Canada), in which she released the album “The Best Damn Thing”, which sold, that same year, more than 6 million copies worldwide. The pop singer rocked the audience to the sound of “Girlfriend” as well as other great hits like “Complicated” and “I'm With You”.

programme.title: Depeche Mode - Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Depeche Mode.

programme.title: The Killers - Live at Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring The Killers.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - The Space Within US
programme.desc: Paul McCartney presents this special performance of the US Tour, made in the United States, 11 weeks and 34 shows, playing great compositions of his solo career along with some Wings and Beatles songs.

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading & Leeds Festival 2022

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 57
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Amigos para sempre T1 - Ep. 17

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 68
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.desc: Alex e Katherine, um casal inglês à beira do divórcio, viaja para Itália para tratar de uma herança. Em Nápoles, os dias separados e as crises conjugais culminam num inesperado reencontro e reconciliação.

programme.title: O Fantasma da Liberdade
programme.desc: Numa Toledo ocupada pelas forças napoleónicas, um soldado abraça uma estátua feminina numa igreja. Depois, exige que se abra o caixão. A história é contada por um criado num jardim público, que prefere ler em vez de tomar conta das filhas dos patrões, os Foucault.

programme.title: Escândalo de Amor
programme.desc: Um industrial italiano contrata um detetive privado para investigar a mulher. Porém, a atitude ciumenta do marido leva a que a jovem se aproxime de um antigo amor. .

programme.title: Diários da Caixa Negra
programme.desc: A jornalista Shiori Ito investiga corajosamente a própria agressão sexual, enfrentando o sistema judiciário e mediático japonês. Com gravações pessoais, imagens de segurança e entrevistas, o seu caso torna-se símbolo de mudança no Japão.

programme.title: Vidas Paralelas
programme.desc: Numa viagem experimental ao futuro, Sean Graves descobre a complexidade de conhecer a sua versão futura, envolvendo-se numa investigação romântica que desafia as fronteiras do tempo e tem consequências nas suas próprias escolhas.

programme.title: Não Esperes Mais T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Daryl e Carol viajam para Tenerife para contar à família dela sobre o seu noivado. Sónia tenta resolver os seus sentimentos por Can e não quer ficar sozinha com ele.

programme.title: Não Esperes Mais T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Sónia não sabe se Can se foi embora para sempre ou não. Viaja para Londres para finalmente confessar os seus sentimentos. Carol sofre uma intervenção da sua família que lhe abre os olhos para seguir em frente e ser feliz com Daryl.

programme.title: Sexualmente Vossa
programme.desc: Gerard Casanova é o homem que todas as mulheres ricas e bonitas chamam quando precisam de um pouco mais do que os maridos lhes podem dar. Ele está sempre à disposição para satisfazer todos os seus desejos sexuais.

programme.title: Negócios de Ocasião
programme.desc: O proprietário de uma pequena empresa e os seus dois sócios viajam para a Europa para fecharem o negócio mais importante das suas vidas. Mas o que começou como uma viagem de negócios vai sair fora dos carris, incluindo escalas não programadas….

programme.title: Emmanuelle - A Antivirgem
programme.desc: Depois dois meses de separação, Emmanuelle viaja ao encontro do marido. Na Tailândia, encontra-o e conhece Christopher, um misterioso piloto de avião..

programme.title: Chicago P.D. T13 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Ruzek fica desconfiado depois de um agente da DEA o contactar para lhe perguntar sobre um informador desaparecido.

programme.title: Chicago P.D. T13 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Chicago P.D. T13 - Ep. 16

programme.title: Chicago P.D. T13 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: As tensões entre Voight e Imani começam a surgir quando uma série de assaltos a caixas multibanco atinge a cidade.

programme.title: Chicago P.D. T13 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Uma festa em casa com consequências fatais leva a Unidade de Informações a descobrir o segredo perturbador de uma família. Atwater chega a uma encruzilhada pessoal crucial.

programme.title: Chicago P.D. T13 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Ruzek examina uma cassete VHS que pertencia ao seu pai, o que leva a resultados inesperados.

programme.title: Saltburn
programme.desc: Nesta perversa história de privilégio e desejo, um estudante vê-se arrastado para o mundo de uma família aristocrática para um verão inesquecível.

programme.title: Reveses da Fortuna
programme.desc: O brilhante professor de direito Alan Dershowitz é contratado pelo milionário Claus Von Bulow, para o defender das acusações de assassinato da sua mulher. Mas como se defende alguém que acreditamos ser culpado? Baseado numa história verídica.

programme.title: A Mais Preciosa Mercadoria
programme.desc: Numa floresta, um casal pobre encontra um bebé lançado de um comboio. Ao protegê-lo, mudam as suas vidas e as de quem cruzam, revelando o melhor e o pior do coração humano, num cenário de guerra e miséria.

programme.title: Além do Jogo
programme.desc: Em 1955, cinco jovens caddies mexicanos-americanos, apaixonados pelo jogo, estavam determinados a aprender a jogar, pelo que criaram o seu próprio campo de golfe no meio do deserto do Sul do Texas.

programme.title: Um Econtro de Natal Perfeito
programme.desc: Num encontro rápido, Marie troca acidentalmente de diário com um desconhecido. À medida que o Natal se aproxima, será que a magia do feriado a ajudará a encontrar o diário certo - e o homem certo - para tornar a sua época natalícia verdadeiramente inesquecível?.

programme.title: As Aventuras de Jack Mimoun
programme.desc: Jack Mimoun é um aventureiro famoso, cujas aventuras são cuidadosamente planeadas e seguras. Porém, Jack é arrastado para uma aventura real pela bela Aurelie, que procura uma espada com jóias, associada ao desaparecimento do seu pai.

programme.title: Um Natal Diferente
programme.desc: Claire, de 10 anos, descobre que os pais estão prestes a separar-se e decide agir. Com a ajuda do avô, transforma um verão italiano num autêntico Natal antecipado. Entre neve falsa, luzes e surpresas inesperadas, tenta reacender a magia familiar.

programme.title: Assim Nasce Uma Estrela
programme.desc: Jackson Maine é um músico consagrado que descobre e se apaixona por Ally , uma cantora que já tinha desistido de realizar o seu sonho. Mas enquanto a carreira de Ally descola, Jack luta contra os seus demónios e a relação entre os dois deteriora-se.

programme.title: O Sorriso das Estrelas
programme.desc: Numa estalagem uma mãe de família que se encontra em processo de divórcio e um cirurgião que acaba de sofrer, também ele, um grande trauma apaixonam-se.

programme.title: O Mistério De Grosse Pointe T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Alice dá as boas-vindas a um novo membro da família; Catherine tem de ajudar a vender a casa onde cresceu.

programme.title: O Mistério De Grosse Pointe T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Chega a noite da gala, mas nada corre como planeado para Birdie, Catherine, Brett ou Alice.

programme.title: As Cinquenta Sombras Mais Negras
programme.desc: Versão alargada nunca antes vista nos cinemas. Nos segundo capítulo da saga, Christian Grey debate-se com os seus demónios interiores e Anastasia tem de confrontar-se com a raiva e a inveja das mulheres que ocuparam o seu lugar no passado.

programme.title: Sei O Que Fizeste No Verão Passado
programme.desc: Cinco amigos encobrem um homicídio após um acidente mortal e juram silêncio. Um ano depois, alguém sabe o que fizeram. Perseguidos por um assassino armado com gancho, procuram ajuda junto dos sobreviventes do Massacre de Southport de 1997.

programme.title: Birth/Rebirth
programme.desc: Uma técnica da morgue reanima o corpo de uma menina mas, para mantê-la viva, precisa de recolher materiais biológicos de grávidas. Quando a mãe da menina descobre que o seu bebé está vivo, as duas fazem um acordo que as leva a um caminho sombrio.

programme.title: Teoria da Conspiração
programme.desc: Jerry Fletcher, um taxista de Nova Iorque e Alice Sutton, funcionária do Ministério de Justiça, vêm-se envolvidos numa complexa conspiração política.

programme.title: Annabelle 3 - O Regresso A Casa
programme.desc: Annabelle, a boneca possuída, está trancada numa sala fechada dentro de uma vitrine benzida. Mas uma noite profana de horror está prestes a acontecer, quando Annabelle desperta os espíritos malignos presentes e todos se voltam para um novo alvo..

programme.title: Um Homem De Família
programme.desc: Dane, um caça talentos que trabalha 70 horas semanais, batalha com Lynn pela posição de diretor da empresa. Quando Dane vê o filho de 10 anos ser internado com leucemia, ele terá de alterar as suas prioridades para salvar a sua família.

programme.title: Weird: A História de Al Yankovic
programme.desc: Explora todas as facetas da vida de Yankovic, desde a sua ascensão meteórica à fama com os primeiros êxitos como “Eat It” e “Like a Surgeon” até aos seus tórridos casos amorosos com celebridades e ao seu famoso estilo de vida depravado.

programme.title: Bem Bom
programme.desc: 1979. Quatro jovens são contratadas para formar uma girl band. Elas sabem cantar, brilham a dançar e escandalizam o país… e tornam-se um fenómeno de popularidade. Elas são as DOCE.

programme.title: Força Devastadora
programme.desc: Uma difícil missão é atribuída ao agente da Interpol Robert ´Bobby´ Samuels na Europa de Leste: acabar com o tráfico de armas e drogas na região dos Balcãs.

programme.title: Caminhos de Sangue
programme.desc: Cliff, um vendedor em dificuldades, aceita um trabalho perigoso com um antigo colega, Ricky, e vê-se arrastado para o submundo do crime, enfrentando violência, traições e escolhas que podem custar-lhe tudo.

programme.title: A Quinta
programme.desc: Fernando, um professor de geografia destruído pelo desaparecimento da mulher, assume a identidade de um jardineiro numa quinta portuguesa. Lá cria uma amizade inesperada com a dona da propriedade e mergulha numa vida que não é sua.

programme.title: Sketch: Cuidado Com O Que Desenhas
programme.desc: Uma menina descobre que os monstros violentos que desenha ganham vida quando o seu caderno cai num lago mágico. Agora, com a cidade em perigo, ela, o irmão e o pai terão de salvar todos — e enfrentar os seus próprios medos.

programme.title: Joker: Loucura a Dois
programme.desc: Arthur Fleck encontra-se institucionalizado em Arkham, à espera de ser julgado pelos seus crimes como Joker. Enquanto luta contra a sua dupla personalidade, Arthur não só encontra o amor verdadeiro, mas também a música que sempre esteve dentro dele.

programme.title: Dune - Duna: Parte Dois
programme.desc: A continuação da jornada mítica de Paul Atreides, que se une agora a Chani e aos Fremen enquanto procura vingança contra aqueles que destruíram a sua família. Perante um futuro terrível, ele terá de escolher entre o amor e o destino do universo.

programme.title: La Piramide
programme.desc: Divertido, con un ritmo trepidante y tremendamente adictivo para los espectadores, `La Pirámide' es un juego de asociación de palabras en el que cada tarde tres concursantes contarán con la ayuda de un personaje conocido para sumar el mayor número de aciertos y poder llevarse 100.

programme.desc: Las nuevas tramas abren paso a un nuevo tablero de juego donde sus protagonistas no solo buscan sobrevivir y salir hacia adelante, sino también echar la vista atrás, recogiendo el legado de los orígenes de la serie: la verdadera razón por la que Adriana y sus hermanos llegaron hasta allí.

programme.desc: Dada como morta no Brasil, Flor ressurge quase vinte anos depois nos Açores, trazendo uma revelação que pode mudar tudo: alguém tentou matá-la em alto-mar. Um encontro com Sammy, o amor da juventude, agora casado com a sua antiga melhor amiga, Maria de Fátima, obriga-a a regressar ao passado, que quase a destruiu, para descobrir a verdade.

programme.title: Secret Story - Desafio Final 2026: Extra
programme.desc: No final da noite, o que andarão os concorrentes da casa mais vigiada do país a fazer?

programme.title: Santa Bárbara - Ep. 91
programme.desc: Das profundezas da terra aos píncaros da alta sociedade, 'Santa Bárbara' conta a história de Gabriela, uma jovem a quem tiram tudo e que regressa para tudo reconquistar. Ao mesmo tempo, é a história de uma esquecida vila portuguesa do interior que vai encontrar um novo fôlego com a reabertura de umas antigas minas de ouro. Tal como a protagonista, que irá passar das maiores provações às maiores riquezas.

programme.title: Mariana - Ep. 189
programme.desc: Uma história intensa, repleta de mistério, romance e emoção. A trama passa-se no início do século XX, em Córdoba, Espanha, onde os segredos da aristocracia se cruzam com as vidas dos criados e dos menos favorecidos.

programme.title: Remédio Santo - Ep. 263
programme.desc: Há trinta anos, Violante estava de casamento marcado com o ambicioso Daniel, inconformado com a pobre vida que tinha. Sequioso de ascensão social, Daniel não hesitou em trocar a namorada pobre e que esperava um filho seu, pela milionária Eugénia Monforte.

programme.title: O Princípio da Incerteza
programme.desc: Um programa de resumo semanal dos principais temas da atualidade, de natureza política, social e económica. Carlos Andrade conduz o formato que tem Alexandra Leitão, José Pacheco Pereira e Miguel Macedo como comentadores.

programme.title: TV Shop
programme.desc: Aspiradores mais potentes do que o motor de um avião, colchões insufláveis, máquinas que transformam a flácida barriga em portentosos abdominais e mais, muito mais, à distância de um telefonema.

programme.title: Os Batanetes
programme.desc: Vários momentos de humor, compostos por sketches hilariantes, são sinónimo de muitas gargalhadas na companhia dos 'Batanetes'.

programme.desc: Os primeiros anos dos heróis de Madagascar Alex o Leão, Marty a Zebra, Melman a Girafa e Gloria a hipopótamo, ao crescerem no Zoológico do Central Park.

programme.title: Diário Da Manhã
programme.desc: A partir das 6:30 da manhã chegam as primeiras notícias do dia, uma síntese dos principais jornais e revistas, bem como informações do trânsito e o estado do tempo.

programme.title: Dois às 10
programme.desc: No programa que anima as manhãs, Cláudio Ramos e Cristina Ferreira fazem-lhe companhia. Um programa diversificado, leve e divertido, mas também com espaço para histórias densas e emotivas.

programme.title: TVI Jornal
programme.desc: Este é o espaço para ficar a saber as principais notícias do dia, às 13:00.

programme.title: A Sentença
programme.desc: Perante casos impetuosos que poderiam ser retirados da vida real, em cada episódio é apresentada uma nova situação, proporcionando debates intensos e análises cuidadosas das evidências e testemunhos.
